result:
The users page now has a search box, a role filter and an Export CSV button. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked, so none of it is checked.

- **Search:** a text box matches the name (first and last together) or the email, ignoring case.
- **Role filter:** a select with All roles, Admin and User, using `ROLES` from `@/lib/authorization`.
- **Table:** it shows only the users that match the current search and role.
- **Export CSV:** the button downloads `users.csv` with the users currently shown, with columns Name, Email, Role and Joined. Joined uses `formatDate`. The button is disabled when no users match.
- **Admins only:** the route already limits the page to admins, so I added no extra check.
- **CSV escaping:** I added `src/utils/csv.ts`, which quotes every cell. It also puts a `'` in front of any cell starting with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@`, so a spreadsheet won't read it as a formula.
- **Edits:** the changes are in `features/users/components/users-list.tsx` and the new `utils/csv.ts`.

The `Input` and `Select` components in `@/components/ui/form` expect a `registration` prop from react-hook-form, which features can't import. I passed `registration={{}}` to `Input` and a plain `onChange` through `registration` on `Select`. It works with the existing components, but it is a little awkward. If you would rather have `Select` take `value` and `onChange` props directly, say so and I'll change it.
